source: lab (captured, Orbbec Femto Mega RGB; background removed with Segment Anything 2 -> black background)

camera.evidence: phase correlation of a ball-free strip (x 200-950, y 575-720) vs frame 0: dx in [-0.12, 0.16] px, dy in [0, 0.25] px over all frames (scene/table_measure.json camera_shift_per_frame)

perspective.table_front_and_back_edges: nearly parallel to image x axis (slopes ~0.05 and ~0.04), i.e. table front edge roughly perpendicular to the optical axis
perspective.note: horizon of the table-top plane is near the image centre row; camera looks slightly down onto the table from a little above it

objects.name: ball
objects.description: yellow-green tennis ball; the only moving object
objects.reference_point: visible centre = centre of a circle fitted to the yellow mask contour (cx, cy); diam_px = fitted circle diameter

phases.state: held still in a hand (hand removed by segmentation) just right of the table's front-right corner, close to the camera; centre ~ (1167-1177, 563), diameter ~99 px
hand starts the throw: ball moves slightly left and away (diameter 99 -> 94 px)
release (between frames 17 and 18; frame 18 first strongly blurred free-flight frame)
ball flies / travels quickly up-left in the image and away from camera over the table (diameter 97 -> 55 px), strong motion blur 18-21
ball reaches the far (back) part of the table; it sits on the table at the back edge; still receding; minimum apparent size ~41 px at frames 29-32 (farthest from camera)
ball rolls left along the far part of the table top and slightly toward the camera (diameter 41 -> 51 px), ~10.5 px/frame leftward; still moving at the last frame

objects.name: hand
objects.description: the thrower's hand; segmented out (black), only visible as a black notch under the ball and small skin-coloured remnants in frames 0-19

objects.name: table
objects.description: rectangular wooden table top (light brown wood grain) on a single dark pedestal; static
objects.note: back-right corner is rounded (hull points (901,467)-(937,477)); the near-right corner region was partly mis-segmented in frames 18-20

objects.name: pedestal
objects.description: dark grey cylindrical table leg/column under the table centre; static; cut off by the image bottom
objects.note: column itself ~630-690 px wide-range; bracket under the table slightly wider (603-700)

events.name: largest image displacement per frame (~74 px)
ball arrives on the far part of the table top
events.uncertainty: +-2 frames; contact not directly visible (no bounce visible)

events.name: farthest from camera / direction change (stops receding, starts moving left and slightly toward camera)
possible dropped/duplicated frame (20 px step vs ~10.5 neighbouring steps)
end of clip, ball still rolling
